quests.sentenceWithBlank: Our office is located on ___ fourth floor of that building.
quests.completedSentence: Our office is located on the fourth floor of that building.
quests.ruleExplanation: Ordinal numbers like 'fourth' identify a position within an existing, known sequence, so they take 'the' — 'the fourth floor' means the floor in that specific position.
quests.nativeTip: This number identifies a specific position among the floors in the building.
quests.example: Our office is located on the fourth floor of that building.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: We're planning to open ___ fourth store in the downtown area next year.
quests.completedSentence: We're planning to open a fourth store in the downtown area next year.
quests.grammarRule: Indefinite article before a consonant sound
quests.ruleExplanation: When 'fourth' simply means 'one more, making four total' rather than identifying a specific position in an existing sequence, it works like a regular counting adjective and takes 'a' — 'a fourth store', similar to 'another store'.
quests.nativeTip: Here 'fourth' is really just counting a new addition, not identifying a position in a known list.
quests.visualAnchor: 🔤 a: Indefinite article before a consonant sound
quests.example: We're planning to open a fourth store in the downtown area next year.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: This is ___ third time this printer has jammed today.
quests.completedSentence: This is the third time this printer has jammed today.
quests.ruleExplanation: Just like 'the fourth floor', this ordinal identifies a specific position — the third occurrence in a series you're counting — so it takes 'the'.
quests.nativeTip: This number is identifying a position in a count you're tracking.
quests.example: This is the third time this printer has jammed today.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: That was hands-down ___ funniest movie I've seen all year.
quests.completedSentence: That was hands-down the funniest movie I've seen all year.
quests.ruleExplanation: Superlatives like 'funniest' compare one thing against an entire group and always take 'the'.
quests.nativeTip: This adjective is being compared against every other movie you've seen.
quests.example: That was hands-down the funniest movie I've seen all year.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: It's ___ funny movie, but not really the best one out there.
quests.completedSentence: It's a funny movie, but not really the best one out there.
quests.grammarRule: Indefinite article before a consonant sound
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Funny' here is a simple, non-comparative description, not a superlative, so it takes 'a' — 'funny' begins with a consonant sound. Compare this with 'the funniest', which ranks it above every other movie.
quests.nativeTip: This time, the adjective isn't comparing it to anything — it's just a plain description.
quests.visualAnchor: 🔤 a: Indefinite article before a consonant sound
quests.example: It's a funny movie, but not really the best one out there.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: She was named ___ most valuable player of the tournament.
quests.completedSentence: She was named the most valuable player of the tournament.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Most valuable' is a superlative phrase, so it takes 'the', following the same pattern as 'the funniest movie'.
quests.nativeTip: This title ranks her above everyone else in the tournament.
quests.example: She was named the most valuable player of the tournament.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: Please turn to ___ next page for further instructions.
quests.completedSentence: Please turn to the next page for further instructions.

quests.nativeTip: This identifies one specific page in a known sequence.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: If you can't make this flight, I can book you on ___ later flight instead.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'A later flight' introduces an unspecified alternative, not one particular identified flight, so it takes 'a'. Compare this with 'the next page', which points to one specific, known item in a sequence.
quests.nativeTip: This isn't one specific, identified flight — it's simply some other, unspecified option.
quests.visualAnchor: 🔤 a: Indefinite article before a consonant sound

quests.sentenceWithBlank: This is ___ final round of interviews before we make a decision.

quests.example: This is the final round of interviews before we make a decision.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: My daughter is still in ___ school — she won't be home until three.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: I need to stop by ___ school to pick up some paperwork from the office.
